note: Remote 9-site Black Hills NF campground in spruce forest on South Fork Rapid Creek, about 8 mi west of Rochford on FSR 231, beside the Black Fox Botanical Area. First-come gravel sites and a vault toilet; no drinking water, so bring your own. Popular on weekends. Free and unserviced in the fall until the road closes for the snowmobile trail. --Claude
